name: Prediko
description:
Give Claude direct access to your inventory.
Search live stock levels, projected and current stock health, SKU details across warehouses, and explore your 12-month demand forecasts. Surface risks you'd otherwise catch too late — stockouts, late purchase orders, excess inventory sitting in the wrong place.
You can draft and edit purchase orders, record received stock, and update SKU planning settings like safety stock, reorder points, lead times, and MOQ. In natural language. With a full audit trail.
Built for Shopify merchants that want their inventory planning to stop living in spreadsheets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Prediko to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Prediko to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.prediko.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Prediko MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prediko lists 13 MCP tools, including create_purchase_order, export_purchase_order, find_entity, get_change_history, get_entity, get_insights, list_entities, receive_units, search_forecasts, search_inventory, search_purchase_orders, and update_purchase_order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Prediko?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Prediko in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Prediko requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Prediko is developed by Prediko. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
